ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(AND( ISNEW(),NOT(Stage_6_7_Updates__c = ''), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) ), AND( ISCHANGED(Stage_6_7_Updates__c ) , NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName ,'6 - Setup')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName ,'7 - Closed')), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) ))
